text.p02: [excited] Glad you made it! [curious] …Hm? That scarf — Grandma knitted it, didn't she?
text.p03a: [happy] Yep, welcome home! [laughs] …Ha ha, that makes me bashful.
text.p03b: [proudly] Of course! I've been waiting here for an hour.
text.p04: [gruffly] Come on, it's cold, let's get home. [chuckles] Grandma's tired of waiting.
text.g01: [excited] Coming, coming…! Oh my, oh my!
text.g02: [whispers] Welcome home… My, how you've grown…
text.g03: [giggles] Hehe, you made it home. [warmly] Come in, come in. I've warmed up the kotatsu.
text.g04: [warmly] Here, oshiruko. It's hot, so blow on it first.
text.p05: [proudly] Grandma's oshiruko is the best in Japan. [gruffly] …Want one of my mandarins too?
text.p06a: [happy] Good, Grandpa'll peel it for you. [proudly] …There, I even took off the white strings.
text.g05b: [excited] Oh, that makes me happy! [warmly] Eat as much as you like.
text.g06: [giggles] Warm in front of the stove, isn't it? Your right cheek's all red.
text.p07: [excited] Morning! Come on, let's make a snowman! Grandpa's is gonna be huge!
text.p09: [laughs heartily] Ha ha ha! Missed, did I?
text.p10: [surprised] Whoa!? C-cold! …Not bad. [chuckles] That's my grandkid.
text.g07: [shouting] You two'll catch a cold! The amazake's ready!
text.g09: [whispers] …When Grandpa was young, one snowy day he said just "Come and live with me" — and turned bright red.
text.g10: [whispers] Hehe… Here, let me tuck the blanket up to your ears.
text.g12a: [whispers] …Mm. We'll be waiting. Grandpa and Grandma both.
text.g12b: [whispers] Hehe… what a lovely thing to say. Come home any time. This is your home.
text.p11: [sleepy] …mumble… my grandkid's… the best in Japan…
